title: Geometric Frobenius action
statement:
Let $q=p^r$ be a prime power, let $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ with fixed algebraic closure $k$, and fix a prime $\ell\neq p$. Choose an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. Retain the coefficient conventions of [def-tw-conventions], namely the common-stage category of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Use its completed-coefficient presentation as follows. A separated finite-type scheme over a field is noetherian and finite-dimensional, and $\ell$ is invertible on $X$ and on $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. On these schemes [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization] identifies the integral full subcategory used by those conventions with [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], inside the same derived category of modules over $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,-}=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_{-}$. Their raw rationalizations therefore agree. The natural maps [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] identify the integral scalar extensions in [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] with those of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]; after rationalization these identify the common-stage presentation [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] with the original coefficient category. These identifications use the identity on integral objects and morphisms and the canonical tensor and reduction maps on coefficient extensions. Compatibility with successive extensions follows on the common finite reductions from $(x\otimes b)\otimes c\mapsto x\otimes bc$ in either order, and the quotient maps defining the completion comparison commute with this formula. Use this presentation for the ordinary and compact-support cohomology notation of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. Write $\sigma:k\to k$, $z\mapsto z^q$, and $\gamma=\sigma^{-1}$. The geometric Galois Frobenius is the scheme automorphism

$$
 \Phi_X=g_X=\operatorname{id}_{X_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma):X\xrightarrow{\sim}X
$$

of [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]; on an affine open obtained from $\operatorname{Spec}A_0\subseteq X_0$ its ring map is $a\otimes b\mapsto a\otimes\gamma(b)$. Let $\Lambda_X=(\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)_X$ be the constant coefficient object with its canonical Weil isomorphism $\theta:L\Phi_X^*\Lambda_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_X$ [def-weil-constant-weil-structure]. It is represented at the coefficient stage $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and all the following constructions are passed from that stage to the common-stage algebraically closed coefficient category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

Using the ordinary and compact-support cohomology functors of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] and their transports $\tau_{\Lambda_X}$ and $\tau_{c,\Lambda_X}$ along $\Phi_X$ [def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport], define

$$
 F_X=R\Gamma(X,\theta)\circ\tau_{\Lambda_X},
 \qquad F_{c,X}=R\Gamma_c(X,\theta)\circ\tau_{c,\Lambda_X}.
$$

These are the global geometric Frobenius operators of [def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius] for the canonical constant Weil object. The transports are isomorphisms by [lem-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport-iso], and $R\Gamma$ and $R\Gamma_c$ carry $\theta$ to isomorphisms. Thus, for every integer $i$, taking cohomology gives the $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-linear automorphisms denoted

$$
 \Phi_X^*=H^i(F_X):H^i(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^i(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell),
 \qquad \Phi_{X,c}^*=H^i(F_{c,X}):H_c^i(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_c^i(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell).
$$

The same notation is used when this construction is repeated after base change, with the specified finite-field model and its geometric Frobenius.

split_report.summary: Maintainer repair: retain the original def-tw-conventions coefficient category. The delivery report incorrectly described its integral coefficients as discrete: def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum explicitly uses the completed ring sheaf. Cite the existing integral stratified-perfect characterization and finite-free completed scalar comparison to identify the finite-stage categories and their transition functors with the completed presentation used for the action. No new comparison theorem is assumed or created. The Frobenius source correction remains: the relative q-power scheme map has no inverse on the affine line, while id × Spec(gamma) is the geometric Galois automorphism. Both cohomology operators are the displayed transport followed by the constant Weil isomorphism. No new nodes. Repair of returned head a1ee02487415: incorporated the approved maintainer fixes, which had not reached the sandbox after the merge-lock timeout. Re-read all fourteen current dependency statements and compared their full JSON with the immutable review snapshot: all unchanged. Introduced X before the coefficient comparisons which use it. The report retracts the earlier discrete-coefficient claim.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\Phi_X$ be the geometric Frobenius endomorphism of
$X_{\overline k}$ (the inverse of the $q$-power map, extended by base
change from $X$). It induces, for every
$i$, a $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-linear automorphism

$$
\Phi_X^*:H^i(X_{\overline k},\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)
\longrightarrow H^i(X_{\overline k},\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell),
$$

and similarly on compactly supported cohomology; the same notation is used
after any base change.
